commit.subject: LU-18687 lnet: make lock.h an internal lnet header
commit.message:
LU-18687 lnet: make lock.h an internal lnet header

The locking code in lock.h is an internal implementation
detail of LNet. It should not be exported for consumption
by other modules (like Lustre).

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Timothy Day <timday@thelustrecollective.com>
Change-Id: I57fa7c1f7c87bb38f6035eb6d1de397195e8d5c1
